title: Motion completion lacks an overall timeout in several wheels/mounts
description:
`wheel_quantum/indigo_wheel_quantum.driver:36-40` repeatedly reads valid `P` positions until the requested slot; a controller continuing to report another slot never lets this synchronous handler return. Individual serial read timeout does not bound a stream of valid replies, so disconnect is queued behind it. Related asynchronous endless-BUSY shapes occur in `wheel_trutek:77-80` (slot0), `wheel_xagyl:99-102` (wrong slot), `wheel_asi:155-156` and calibration175-176 (`pos == -1`), `wheel_playerone:149-155` (the30-poll bound applies only to initial target0, not ordinary motion), `mount_pmc8:620-622` (moving park rates), and `mount_temma:297-301` (GOTO status s1; park already has a deadline). Remediation: use monotonic operation deadlines and bounded finalizers, retain last measured position and requested target, publish ALERT on expiry, and perform protocol-supported stop/recovery. Characterize stationary/wrong-target/endless-moving replies plus queued abort/disconnect. Bounded transport transactions alone are not whole-operation timeouts. Additional current paths: nfocus138-152, optec208-211 and nexstar1030-1033 requeue valid in-progress replies without an overall deadline; bounded polls keep abort serviceable but do not bound completion. Next: include these drivers in deadline and recovery follow-up.
